headline: ECB Officials Weigh October Rate Hike Amid Ongoing Energy Shock Pressures
summary: ECB minutes reveal a large number of Governing Council members could have backed a rate hike in October, though policymakers ultimately held rates steady as an energy shock unfolded.
why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the eurozone, directly influencing borrowing costs, inflation, and the euro across member nations.

impacts.name: Eurozone benchmark interest rate
impacts.why: Discussion of potential rate hikes directly concerns the trajectory of central bank policy rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Discussions of potential rate hikes by central bank officials increase market uncertainty regarding future borrowing costs and monetary policy tightening.
